■ Stage Direction
Please deliver with a sad, pleading appeal toward the Trainer.

I want to be there for Biko Pegasus.
With that in mind, I voiced the words she had once taught me.

Good for you, kiddo! Actually, I already have another one!
So make sure you take good care of that mask!

Looking over toward the voice, I saw a young boy.
He was completely out of breath, as if he had been searching everywhere for that mask.

! Heheh...! There you are, Grease Monster Lardron!
I won't let you have your way!

Full of nutrients! Full of justice!
Carotene Charge—Carrotman!!
I'll protect everyone's health!!

So... this much is nothing... to me....
——....

When I was little! Wearing this mask made me
feel like I could really become the hero I admired!
Trainer...! Yeah!

I want to become the greatest hero, the kind that puts smiles on everyone's faces
——together with you, Trainer!

The squeeze I felt in my chest was real, too.
...So, you know, if I ever feel like giving up again...

She was breathing softly in her sleep. It felt wrong to wake her...
...That's when an idea popped into my head.

The festival stall corner at the hot springs...!
They really had a Carrotman mask!!

Do you love Carrotman too...?
....
(...Just a little longer... like this——)

Ah, don't get me wrong! When that kid at the festival
smiled, I was truly happy! But——

I don't want to give up on the Carrotman mask...!
Will you help me look for it...?

As her Trainer, and as her fellow hero.
I strongly felt the urge to support her.

One Carrotman mask, please!
...Huh?

When your heart feels weak, you lean on your comrades to get your energy back.
The hero I looked up to said that. So——

I'm totally fine!
Because heroes fight for everyone's smiles!

Yeah, having you around, Trainer...
...No... being able to rely on you, Trainer—I'm so glad I could!

! ...Um, hey.
You're my fellow hero, right, Trainer?

But they're airing reruns of Carrotman right now!
So maybe they might be sellin'... Hm?

I wanted to play pretend Carrotman just like when I was little.
So... could you play along for just a bit?

Trainer, hurry, hurry-!
It's already started-!

Man, talk about nostalgia, "Nutritional Warrior Carrotman"!
There weren't many left, but I'm glad we could buy a mask~.
Haa... haa...! Damn it...!

Because when you get strength from your comrades,
you can get back on your feet no matter how many times it takes.

There's something I want to ask of you, Trainer...
It might sound a bit selfish, but... you see...!

But it broke from playing with it so much...!
I've always wanted to get my hands on one again...!
When that happens... can I lean on you, Trainer?

Right in the middle of summer training camp. After training ended,
Biko Pegasus brought me to——
All... riiiight-!! Well then, mister——

Oh, there you are! Heard you were still looking for one,
and a place came to mind. Maybe if you check over there...

Yeah! ...Hey, we still have
plenty of time before curfew, right?

Are you sure...? Yay, thank you!
I'll treasure it forever, big sis!

Eh... WHAAAAT-!?
Tr-Trainer! This is bad, we gotta hurry...!

Ah, I used to have one when I was little!
It was super rare though, and I haven't seen one since!

First, we gotta look for my treasure...
the Carrotman mask!

Biko Pegasus's weight didn't bother me in the slightest.
Trying gently not to wake her, I started heading into the camp lodge——

(...Ehehe... Trainer's back...
is so warm...)

(...? ...Am I... swaying...?
Could it be——...)

Thanks, this is far enough!
Heheh... sorry for making you take care of me.

Heheh... Did you see that, Trainer?!
That kid's smile was the best!

I went around to every mask stall at the festival with her. However,
it seemed the Carrotman masks were sold out everywhere——

You're in luck, little lady! They're sold out everywhere else!
So that right there is genuinely the very last one.

...-! Amazing!
This isn't a dream, right...?!

Even heroes are allowed to lean on their friends
when they feel like crying, right?

Ah... Look at that!
Check it out, Trainer!

You know... I used to think heroes had to be strong.
So I thought I shouldn't rely on anyone... but.

Whoa-! It really feels like summer!
Grilled carrots and cotton candy sound great, but——

After talking with the stall owner, I slipped away from the festival with Biko Pegasus.
Running with all our might clinging to a glimmer of hope, we finally——

After staging an epic battle with the little Carrotman and having our fill of fun,
we decided to take the bus back to the camp lodge... however.
